description: This file defines a Java interface named CompatActionBarNavListener that listens for navigation events related to news categories, as part of an Android news reader application.

classes.name: CompatActionBarNavListener
classes.description: An interface for listening to navigation events, specifically when a news category is selected.

methods.name: onCategorySelected
methods.description: Called when a news category is selected, with the category's index as a parameter.
